periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the snout-to-ear facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the major axis approximately 1.8 times the length of the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering, where the inferior margin is more distant from the centroid than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide lateral band, occupying approximately 40% of the visible distance between the shoulder and the mid-torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear spatial separation between the dark ear regions, approximately equal to the diameter of one ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded superior curvature.
